changelog:
- Initial release of pdf2md-universal: a universal PDF to Markdown converter designed for efficiency and token saving.
- Three-layer strategy: uses pdftotext for text PDFs, automatically falls back to OCR for scanned PDFs, and provides a token usage comparison report for every conversion.
- Supports both structured content extraction and token estimation mode to help users assess potential token and cost savings before converting.
- Reports expected token consumption for direct PDF reading vs. Markdown, demonstrating cost efficiency.
- Handles common PDF types (research reports, financials, scanned documents) and outlines known limitations.
summary: Convert any PDF (text or scanned) into structured Markdown with token usage report, enabling 3-10x token savings for AI reading or archiving.
